name: Ghost Data Exchange for Interpolation and Gradients
aliases: Boundary Voxel Replication for Distributed Memory
Ghost Cell Stitching for Distributed Memory
definition: Two layers of ghost data are required: one layer for trilinear interpolation of sampled values, and a second layer for computing the gradient field via central differences.
summary: Ghost Data Exchange maintains data consistency across node boundaries in distributed-memory volume rendering by replicating boundary voxels to support local interpolation and gradient estimation without frequent inter-node fetches.
